name: Tiangong
summary: A fully electric running humanoid from Beijing's state-backed humanoid innovation center, released as open source: hardware, motion-control and embodied-AI software in graded 'Lite / Pro / MAX' versions. Tiangong runs at around 10 km/h, handles slopes, stairs, grass and sand, and anchors a large open developer community; it was also the platform for the 2025 Beijing humanoid half-marathon.
notable: Basis of a 100+ unit open developer community and a public half-marathon

sources.title: Tiangong: World's 1st electric humanoid robot goes open source — Interesting Engineering
